# Taxjar

TaxJar provides a comprehensive sales tax API for real-time tax calculations, reporting, and filing.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/taxjar/.

## Actions

- **Calculate Sales Tax For An Order** (read-only): Calculate sales tax for an order.
- **Create Order Transaction**: Create a new order transaction.
- **Create Refund Transaction**: Create a new refund transaction.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete an existing customer.
- **Delete Order Transaction**: Delete an existing order transaction.
- **Delete Refund Transaction**: Delete an existing refund transaction.
- **List Customers** (read-only): List existing customers.
- **List Nexus Regions** (read-only): List existing nexus regions for an account.
- **List Order Transactions** (read-only): List existing order transactions.
- **List refund transactions** (read-only): List refund transactions.
- **List Tax Categories** (read-only): List all product tax categories and their codes.
- **Show Customer** (read-only): Show an existing customer.
- **Show Order Transaction** (read-only): Show an existing order transaction by id.
- **Show Refund Transaction** (read-only): Show a refund transaction.
- **Show Tax Rates for a Location** (read-only): Show sales tax rates for a location.
- **Summarize Tax Rates for All Regions** (read-only): Retrieve minimum and average sales tax rates by region.
- **Update Order Transaction**: Update an existing order transaction.
- **Validate VAT Number** (read-only): Validate a vat number for tax-exempt status.
